_doc: Town buildings in every player's field (owner round 2, R2.3). Read by js/sim/buildings.js. `kinds`: what each building does; `radius` = how close (m, from the building centre to the hero centre) a hero must stand to use it, or null = usable from anywhere (select the building like any other). `size` [w, d] in metres for the view; `door` = which way the entrance faces (+z = toward the Keep and the camera). `layouts`: field-local positions per map (x = 0 the field centre, z grows toward the Keep), optionally per mode (`modes.<mode>` overrides `default`); a map without a row uses `fallback`. One set of buildings per TEAM field; in team modes every teammate uses the same buildings. Ids are `t<team>.<kind>`.

shop.name: Outfitter
shop.desc: Sells weapons, armour, trinkets, charms and consumables. Your hero must stand next to it to buy or sell.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.desc: Hire units and send them down your rival's lane. Every unit you hire raises your income. Usable from anywhere.

drillyard.name: Drill Yard
drillyard.desc: Train your army: upgrades apply to every unit you send, including the ones already on the field. Usable from anywhere.

sanctum.name: Sanctum
sanctum.desc: Buy one-shot powers and cast them where you choose: defensive in your own field, offensive in an enemy field, neutral anywhere. Usable from anywhere.
